pages.title: Display
pages.description: Arrangement, brightness, color, scale, resolution, and refresh rate
pages.reason: Display controls work through Hyprland. Graphics is not implemented yet.

controls.title: Selected display
controls.reason: The settings below apply to this display.

controls.title: Position
controls.reason: Top-left corner in the layout, in logical pixels. You can also drag the display above.

controls.title: Refresh displays
controls.reason: Read the connected displays again. Hyprland also reports connections as they happen.

controls.title: Brightness
controls.reason: Hardware brightness: kernel backlight on built-in panels, DDC/CI on external displays.

controls.title: Color preset
controls.reason: Hyprland color management preset for this display.

controls.title: HDR
controls.reason: Use Hyprland's HDR preset. Available only when the display reports HDR support.

controls.title: Night light
controls.reason: Opens the Night light page.

controls.title: Scale
controls.reason: Lists sizes Hyprland keeps exact. Auto lets Hyprland decide from the pixel density.

controls.title: Resolution
controls.reason: Use the preferred mode or enter X and Y in pixels. Custom sizes snap to the nearest mode reported by the display.

controls.title: Refresh rate
controls.reason: Rates available at the current resolution.

controls.title: Orientation
controls.reason: Choose rotation and horizontal flip independently.

controls.title: Multiple displays
controls.reason: Extend the desktop, mirror another display, or stop using this one.

sections.title: Advanced
sections.description: Display details and specialist Hyprland options

controls.title: Desktop mode
controls.reason: Logical size after scale and rotation.

controls.title: Active signal mode
controls.reason: Resolution and refresh rate sent to the display.

controls.title: Color space
controls.reason: Active color preset and pixel format.

controls.title: Display information
controls.reason: Manufacturer, model, serial number, and physical size reported by the display.

controls.title: Bit depth
controls.reason: Color depth per channel on the display link.

controls.title: Variable refresh rate
controls.reason: Matches refresh to rendering on displays that support it. Use Hyprland default follows misc:vrr.

controls.title: SDR transfer function
controls.reason: How SDR content is decoded when color management is active.

controls.title: SDR brightness in HDR
controls.reason: Multiplier for SDR content while this display uses HDR. Saved when you press Enter or leave the field.

controls.title: SDR saturation in HDR
controls.reason: Multiplier for SDR saturation while this display uses HDR.

controls.title: SDR minimum luminance
controls.reason: Black level used when mapping SDR to HDR, in nits.

controls.title: SDR maximum luminance
controls.reason: White level used when mapping SDR to HDR, in nits.

controls.title: Display minimum luminance
controls.reason: Overrides the reported minimum, in nits. -1 uses the reported value.

controls.title: Display peak luminance
controls.reason: Overrides the reported peak, in nits. -1 uses the reported value.

controls.title: Display average luminance
controls.reason: Overrides the reported maximum average, in nits. -1 uses the reported value.

controls.title: HDR capability
controls.reason: Override what the display reports. Forcing it on can produce a wrong picture.

controls.title: Wide color capability
controls.reason: Override what the display reports. Forcing it on can produce a wrong picture.

controls.title: ICC profile
controls.reason: Absolute path to a profile. Clearing it applies after the next Hyprland configuration reload.

controls.title: Reserved area
controls.reason: Space kept free of tiled windows, as four numbers: top right bottom left.
